title: Embed a feature someone else shipped
problem: Another team shipped their app as a feature package; I need it running inside my page, alive and observable, without learning their stack.
outcome: A generated shell package installed and opened embedded in a host page, with proof-of-life events driving a live indicator, a silence deadline that degrades to a fallback when the feature goes quiet, and a clean teardown.

knowledge: A browser host app (the worked example is Next.js/React, but nothing here depends on React)
The shell package the feature team gave you: a registry name or a tarball
